requiredFindings.title: Establish descriptor isolation and continuous control ownership
requiredFindings.problem: The namespace guarantee omits inherited cgroup-control descriptors and access to writable ancestor controls. Either can defeat completeness while final emptiness/read checks pass.
requiredFindings.impact: A run can escape the measured subtree or lose its earlier memory-controller high-water and still be called complete.
requiredFindings.requestedChange: Specify and verify a descriptor allowlist/close-on-exec boundary and mount/access isolation that deny outside controls and preserve controller identity for the whole interval. Keep ordinary credentials and capability drop. If not established, report cgroup-escape-unprevented. Calibrate both inherited-descriptor migration and ancestor-controller interference.
requiredFindings.evidence: Two source-derived, unexecuted counterexamples are detailed in REVIEW.md. Ordinary namespace-local migration is correctly bounded.

requiredFindings.title: Remove the universal anonymous-RSS bound and qualify first-touch accounting
requiredFindings.problem: The run's charge peak is not a universal bound on mapped anonymous resident memory, and placement in the leaf does not charge every touched page there.
requiredFindings.impact: The report misstates the measurement's coverage and conservatism.
requiredFindings.requestedChange: Remove the universal inequality; qualify entry as placement for subsequent accounting, with inherited/shared/external ownership limits. Preserve the charged-memory label and D13 decision. Align the harness wording with the separately corrected quality-plan amendment.

requiredFindings.title: Make leaf validation compatible with unavailable or missing evidence
requiredFindings.problem: Every measured slot must name a distinct actual leaf through its operational record, but declared unavailable-host/platform cases create no leaf, and record-missing is explicitly allowed.
requiredFindings.impact: A legitimate incomplete result either becomes invalid or needs invented evidence; the preserved known-sample case contradicts the new invariant.
requiredFindings.requestedChange: Condition actual-leaf identity and uniqueness on creation, define absent-leaf evidence for typed incomplete cases, and specify independent driver evidence or a record-present-only check for missing records. Preserve QD-27 known values. Add design reference cases for unavailable Linux, macOS, and measured record-missing.

requiredFindings.title: Bind memory budget ratios to a compatible charged-memory baseline
requiredFindings.problem: Q6 now carries charged-memory samples, but both schema variants retain baselinePeakRssBytes and the budget rule still applies the product memory ratio without defining a compatible denominator.
requiredFindings.impact: A reviewed old RSS baseline can produce a meaningless within/over status for the new metric.
requiredFindings.requestedChange: Give the baseline explicit charged-memory semantics and an accurate carrier name, and bind it to reviewed compatible measurement/reset/cache conditions. Do not reuse an RSS baseline by implication. Until such a baseline exists, use no-baseline or an explicitly approved exploratory absolute-charge comparison; retain the G13/D13 boundary.

nonBlockingObservations.title: Correct ENV's stale AQP citations and pin the cited revision
nonBlockingObservations.observation: ENV still cites AQP:419-425 and :535. For the requested r5 basis the intended envelope/D13 targets are PLAN-r5.md:428-434 and :544. Live PLAN.md advanced to r6 during review; cite a pinned snapshot or remap deliberately. DESIGN's sampled mechanical remaps were correct for r5.

nonBlockingObservations.title: Clarify descendant settlement and elapsed end after withdrawing tracing
nonBlockingObservations.observation: Empty cgroup membership does not prove every descendant was reaped or successful. State how the retained descendant-reaping requirement and elapsed end cover daemonized descendants, bounded cleanup and failed settlement after root exit. Keep the existing run-failure rule separate from the memory-counter read.

requestAssessment.cgroupMethod: Fresh leaves, pre-exec placement, post-drain reading and page-cache ownership disclosure fit a per-run charged-memory metric. Containment/control continuity and the universal RSS claim require R9-01/02.
requestAssessment.launcherCapabilities: Creating the leaf-rooted cgroup namespace with CAP_SYS_ADMIN then dropping all workload capabilities is sound in principle; it does not revoke inherited descriptors or ordinary filesystem control access.
requestAssessment.nulling: The six cgroup reasons plus two additional memory reasons match QD-27. Only cgroup-not-empty invalidates elapsed as well as memory among those reasons. Record missing/invalid preserves known samples; any reason remains incomplete and excluded from Q6.
requestAssessment.schema: Static JSON inspection found all 40 object schemas closed and no floating-point fields; withdrawn sample/mode fields and reasons are removed. New leaf invariant and retained RSS baseline need R9-03/04.
requestAssessment.standing: RS3 is unchanged. Charged Q6 measurements stay exploratory; D13 owns qualification equivalence. This does not accept the separately proposed quality-plan amendment.

dependencySnapshot.note: Live PLAN.md advanced to proposal r6 during this review. Its preserved r5 snapshot matches the requested dependency hash. This review assesses the pinned Q0 r9 subjects and their r5 citations.

scopeAssessment.description: The r8 delta fits the announced cgroup replacement, withdrawn mechanisms, reason/carrier/validator changes, preregistration, D12/OI updates and AQP citation remapping.

verification.method: Read-only subject and retained-r8 comparison; static schema/carrier/citation checks; three independent challenge slices; primary Linux source and documentation inspection.
